name: Review AI ad copy with Claude and route it to HubSpot and Slack

parameters.content:
## Review AI ad copy with Claude and route it to HubSpot and Slack

### How it works

This workflow receives ad copy variants by webhook, validates and normalizes them, prevents duplicate processing, then asks Claude to classify the variant and decide the right routing. It plans follow-up actions, optionally creates a HubSpot task and posts a Slack alert in live mode, logs every outcome, and responds to the sender. A separate reporting lane can run manually or on a daily schedule to summarize the action log, ask Claude for insights, and distribute the digest by email, Slack, HTML, and Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook URL and expected payload fields for incoming ad variants, including brief and variant identifiers used for idempotency.
- Add Anthropic API credentials or headers for both Claude HTTP request nodes, and set the desired Claude model in the routing/report configuration nodes.
- Configure HubSpot API authentication and task object fields for the HubSpot task creation node.
- Configure Slack bot token/authentication and set the urgent, review, and digest channel IDs in the relevant Set nodes.
- Set up the n8n Data Table used as the action log and ensure both the processing and reporting lanes point to the same table.
- Configure Gmail credentials and recipient email for report delivery.
- Configure Google Sheets credentials and target spreadsheet/sheet for the decision export.
- Review the Live Mode condition so testing runs can assemble/log outcomes without posting to external systems.

### Customization

You can tune the validation rules, Claude prompts, fallback routing rules, Slack channels, report lookback window, and live-mode behavior to match your campaign review process.

## Receive and validate variant

Webhook intake, routing defaults, gatekeeper validation, and blocked-request handling for invalid ad variants before any AI or external action runs.

## Deduplicate ad variants

Checks the action log for an existing brief/variant combination and returns a duplicate outcome without reprocessing when the item was already handled.

## Ask Claude to route

Builds the structured prompt and sends the ad variant, brief, and campaign context to Claude for a routing decision.

## Validate routing decision

Checks Claude's response for a usable decision and falls back to deterministic routing rules if the AI output is invalid.

## Plan execution actions

Converts the approved or fallback decision into payloads and branches between live execution and dry-run outcome assembly.

## Create task and alert

In live mode, creates the HubSpot task and posts the appropriate Slack alert for reviewers or urgent handling.

## Log and respond

Assembles the final processing outcome, writes it to the action log, and sends the webhook response back to the caller.

## Start report run

Manual and scheduled report triggers converge into shared report configuration such as lookback period, report email, run ID, and Slack digest channel.

## Read and aggregate log

Ensures the action log table is available, reads recent rows, and computes operational statistics for the reporting window.

## Generate AI insights

Builds a batch-insights request from the aggregate stats and sends it to Claude to identify patterns and recommendations.

## Build readable report

Combines computed statistics and Claude insights into report content for the downstream delivery and export channels.

## Send report digest

Delivers the generated report to people through Gmail and posts the digest summary to Slack.

## Export report records

Saves the report as an HTML file and prepares/appends tidy decision rows to Google Sheets for shared analysis.
